name: Test Frontend Build
description: Test if the frontend can build successfully

steps.note: This will start the dev server on http://localhost:3000

verification: ✅ API calls work (when backend is running)
✅ Inventory page shows products with filters

troubleshooting.compilation_errors: Check that all imports are correct and components exist
troubleshooting.api_errors: Ensure backend is running on http://localhost:5000
troubleshooting.missing_components: Verify all component files exist in src/components/
troubleshooting.routing_errors: Check that all page components are properly imported in App.js
